meta.name: cull-release-prepare
meta.description: Use when the user explicitly asks to prepare or bump a Cull patch, minor, or major release, curate its changelog and compatibility review, or create its focused release commit without publishing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动准备软件版本发布并整理变更日志
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你负责项目的版本发布和变更日志维护
copy.tagline_en: Automate release preparation and changelog generation for your project
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage version bumps and release commits for your software project

howto.what: Claude 会按步骤准备一个可复现的发布提交，检查代码、整理变更日志和兼容性审查，最后创建带版本号的提交，但不推送、不打标签。
howto.when: 当你明确要求准备或提升 Cull 的 patch/minor/major 版本，或要求整理变更日志和兼容性审查，或创建发布提交而不发布时触发。

say.text: 帮我准备 Cull 的一个 patch 版本发布。
say.note: 触发 patch 版本发布准备流程。

say.text: 整理 Cull 的变更日志和兼容性审查。
say.note: 要求整理发布所需的文档。

say.text: 创建一个 minor 版本的发布提交，但不要发布。
say.note: 触发 minor 版本发布提交创建。

howto.what_en: Claude follows strict steps to prepare one reproducible release commit: verifies code state, curates changelog and compatibility review, then creates a chore(release) commit without pushing or tagging.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you explicitly ask to prepare or bump a Cull patch/minor/major release, curate its changelog and compatibility review, or create a focused release commit without publishing.

say_en.text: Prepare a patch release for Cull.
Curate the changelog and compatibility review for Cull.
Create a minor release commit without publishing.
